notes.title: 🚀 Big News, Mithrall Adventurers! 🚀
notes.content:
[p]We’re thrilled to unveil our [b]brand-new Steam store page[/b] — fresh, polished, and ready to show off our world: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2838890/Mithrall/"]Mithrall on Steam[/url] But that’s not all…
[/p][p]Our [b]first official game trailer[/b] is now live on both YouTube and TikTok![/p][p]
[b]Check it out and share the hype:[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GbLyFnmruqo"][/dynamiclink][/p][p] - [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@mithrall/video/7540326534968577336"]Watch on TikTok[/url][/p][p]
[b]We need you![/b] Help us spread the word — every like, share, and wishlisted copy helps grow the Mithrall realm.
[/p][p]And the best part? This is just the beginning! Expect [b]new devblogs on the horizon[/b], packed with updates, stories, and behind-the-scenes sneak peeks.
[/p][p]Thank you for being with us on this journey, let's build this legend together![/p][p]— The Mithrall Team[/p]

notes.title: Post March Playtest Devblog – April Update & New Playtest
notes.content:
[h1]🛠️ Post March Playtest Devblog – April Update & New Playtest[/h1]

Greetings adventurers,

Following the March playtest, we've been hard at work improving every aspect of Mithrall based on your feedback. This update brings a massive wave of [b]new features[/b], [b]UI overhauls[/b], [b]tool reworks[/b], and [b]gameplay polish[/b].

We’re also thrilled to announce that the [b]next playtest is happening this weekend[/b] — and this time, [b]registrations are directly on Steam![/b]

[quote]
👉 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2838890/Mithrall/]Request Access on the Steam Page[/url]
[/quote]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]📚 Tech Tree Rework & UI Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Improved tooltip positioning  
[*] Tooltip now shows total crafting cost and required workbenches  
[*] Warnings added when missing prerequisite researches  
[*] Locked items now show costs and locked icon  
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292928/7d4d1ec354c32a7b7bc6fac66a7772c7f3e44e58.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292928/daf2b8edde8844be9f143efb531a4bac827a1072.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🧠 Tutorial & Quest UI Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Tutorial window can now be minimized and expanded  
[*] Close button more visible  
[*] Two new tutorials:
  - Own your base (Influence Chest + Door)
  - Create a respawn point (Sleeping Bag)  
[*] Quest UI now displays XP rewards with better layout  
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292928/28ab75baaa8d7880a7d2a7894103e64d24d862e5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292928/f87758dc7eafb5d8f9ce1df1b78f1d0e9a9af981.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292928/deae3f9ab73dd38b0d95f0abfa885c8d776550fb.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🧪 Crafting UI & System Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Unknown items now appear as silhouettes in crafting queue  
[*] Primitive crafting queue includes new icons and border timer  
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292928/433dc478b5ee22bab1ebd54fd3b86d4ede9af668.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🎯 Quality System Rebalance[/h2]

The crafting quality system was completely reworked!

Previously, players reached [i]Masterpiece[/i] quality too quickly. With the new system, the "quality band" progresses with skill level, making higher-tier results a meaningful achievement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292928/380c4c3127e0074916a4889c0ac29934a4e88e50.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]💬 Context Menu System[/h2]

We’ve added a brand new context menu in the chat UI!

[list]
[*] Mute  
[*] Report  
[*] Invite to Clan  
[*] Admin actions (for moderators)  
[/list]

This system will soon expand across other game systems such as clan management and Influence Chests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292928/645901868d3385470685aecc85ed92b3a9bf48eb.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🧩 Puzzle Tools & Level Design Overhaul[/h2]

We’ve added tons of tools to build dynamic puzzle gameplay and interactive dungeon logic:

[list]
[*] Player/enemy detection zones  
[*] Pressure plates with FX and trigger logic  
[*] Levers with sound, rotation, and reset behavior  
[*] Delay-based logic (e.g. delayed chests after puzzle solved)  
[*] Global FX spawner (visuals, sounds, particles)  
[*] Enhanced dungeon receptacles and interactive sequences  
[/list]

Here are some puzzle showcases:

[h2]🎵 Keriathor’s Forest Music & Creature Sound Updates[/h2]

Every devblog brings a new theme track — this time, welcome to [b]Keriathor’s Forest[/b]. A blend of bagpipes and piano sets a mystical and slightly dark tone, evoking both beauty and danger.

[h2]📜 Questline & PvP Contracts[/h2]

We’ve implemented an introductory questline with rewards like:

[list]
[*] Tools  
[*] Bandages  
[*] XP  
[*] Knowledge Fragments  
[/list]

PvP missions are now live — complete contracts such as:

[quote]
[b]“Bring back X dwarven ears from fallen enemies.”[/b]
[/quote]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🛒 New Shop System & Mounts[/h2]

Two exciting new systems:

[b]🛍️ NPC Vendor Shops:[/b]  
Purchase basic gear and helpful supplies to get started faster.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292928/60b716c16eb49e6905c48d9387c3f648da27a672.png[/img]

Players can now buy horses in the starting area and begin riding across Mithrall! This is just the beginning of the mount system — more types will come in future updates.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🐞 Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Bank items no longer vanish on reopen  
[*] Bank UI no longer shows other players’ inventories  
[*] Coin cost now applies when buying extra bank pages  
[*] Quest items with improper quality now fixed  
[*] Tablet fabricator interaction now works reliably  
[*] UI overlaps, tutorial triggers, and health bar display cleaned up  
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🎮 Playtest Starts This Weekend![/h2]

[b]📅 Dates:[/b] Mai 2 (Friday) – Mai 4 (Sunday)  
[b]⏰ Start Time:[/b] Friday at 6 PM CET

[quote]
We’ve already passed [b]1000 signups[/b] — help us reach [b]2,000+[/b] by sharing the playtest!

[b]Thank you for helping us shape this world — see you in Mithrall![/b]  
— The Mithrall Dev Team 🛡️

notes.title: 🛠️ Mithrall Devblog – A Massive Update & Next Playtest !
notes.content:
Hello, adventurers! It’s been a long time since our last [b]devblog[/b], but that’s because we’ve been [b]working hard[/b] behind the scenes to bring Mithrall to the next level. Today, we’re thrilled to share a [b]massive update[/b] with new content, improved systems, fresh visuals, and, of course, details about the [b]next playtest[/b]!

📅 [b]Next Playtest Date:[/b]
🕒 [b]Starts[/b]: March 28th (Evening)
🕒 [b]Ends[/b]: March  30th (Evening)

If you haven’t registered yet, [b]sign up here[/b]:
🌐 [url=https://www.mithrall.com]Register Now[/url]

Now, let’s dive into [b]everything we’ve been working on[/b]!


[h2][b]🎓 New Tutorials – Learn to Survive![/b] (Ulysse)
[/h2]We’ve been working on new tutorial systems to make the game more accessible while still keeping the freedom that Mithrall is all about. New tutorial videos have been added to the game, covering:

✅ Movements
✅ Collecting Resources
✅ Primitive Crafting
✅ Active Crafting (Workbenches)
✅ Tailor Workbench
✅ Corpse Harvesting
✅ Combat

These tutorials will help newcomers get started while keeping the learning process immersive and engaging.

[previewyoutube=5dFqGRR1rzo;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=V70T1Mahdl4;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2][b]🎶 New Music & Soundscapes (Leo)
[/b][/h2]🔊 [b]Etherion Highlands Theme[/b]

The maps are growing, and with them, [b]new soundscapes[/b] to create an immersive experience. This new music composition has [b]three distinct phases[/b] that build toward an [b]emotional climax[/b], blending:

🎻 [b]Strings & Harp[/b] – To create a mystical feel
🎷 [b]Wind Instruments[/b] – Such as clarinet & English horn for rich melodies
🎺 [b]Brass [/b]– To intensify dramatic moments

🔊 [b]Animals & Creatures Sounds[/b]

We’ve also overhauled the [b]sound detection system[/b] for animals and creatures to make sure they’re [b]easily recognizable[/b] in the world, no more straining your ears to hear distant threats!

[b]🔨 Work in Progress:[/b]
✔️ Improved [b]village ambiance[/b] for a livelier world
✔️ New [b]emote sounds[/b] for better interactions
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/8aed38634103921f23e4b94d1ee38d24bc439840.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/3f9248c1572f6a4cbba3b2ba18d824b06626aaee.png[/img]
[b]🎵 Listen to a sneak peek of the new music below![/b]
[i][🎶 Music Preview 🎶][/i]
[previewyoutube=5CSgmA9k3U8;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][h2]🏗️ New Character Rendering System (Julien)
[/h2][/b]Previously, our characters used [b]multiple skinned mesh renderers[/b], making performance heavy when many players were in one place.

[b]Now, we’ve implemented UMA (Unity Multipurpose Avatar), which:
[/b]✅ [b]Optimizes character performance[/b] – fewer draw calls, better FPS
✅ [b]Reduces texture load[/b] – everything is now merged into one mesh

[b][h3]✨ New Character Models & Customization[/h3][/b]
🧝 [b]New Dwarf Model![/b]
👕 [b]New Clothes & Armors![/b] (Over 30 new outfits / armors)
⚙️ [b]Customizable Body Features! [/b](Early preview)
♀️ [b]Female Character Option Added![/b]
🛡️ [b]First look at craftable armor![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/dda2dd7b845620e1c2f97754b1476085626da64e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/fc5a91e604de0121f658671943433e475c44d083.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/8a5b62889e31d5a5c5cf62e88642c4c66a58e034.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=AOsXkyMZSlM;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][h2]🌍 Level Design & New Zones (Magnus)
[/h2][/b]The world of Mithrall is expanding! We’ve created new areas, improving diversity in environments, from [b]lush forests[/b] to [b]open plains[/b] and [b]dangerous enemy lairs[/b].

[b][h3]📍New Zones (WIP)[/h3][/b]
🌲 [b]Keriathor Forest[/b] – Mysterious woodland, home to hidden dangers
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/a500fabfeb44b424d2534f5506711a5c4756342e.jpg[/img]
🌿 [b]Esmerald Meadows[/b] – A dynamic area where players can build, trade, and fight
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/a1c742f98e1c927829205121f145784048b2a39e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/18a5fcd5bd46b9eeac419a31a77b49033f46c403.jpg[/img]
🏔️ [b]Etherion Highlands[/b] – Vast, open landscapes filled with secrets
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/d0e5cf37bb2a00729e1fd5cb859c88b0fca1a6bb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/cb7c7793c093695aaee037a16ff1ae90176664fb.jpg[/img]

🔧 [b][h3]Improvements & Additions[/h3][/b]
🌳  [b]20-30 new trees with custom colliders & harvestable data[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/b17e8a7c51bcb91e1913113ad6717ceb923cfd1c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/fec3bc14ad2a8846493e5497c150123a189fd6cb.jpg[/img]
🐉  [b]20+ new enemy locations with unique encounters[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/f13354031452151bf46a1e2ce31bba81b7831935.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/a1a23e1c64d40854e704ec1e570eadb7ca496ef1.jpg[/img]
💀  [b]Introducing the ORCS![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/49835aea2317e9feca6d8140f5c1871dbd105666.jpg[/img]

[b][h2]⚔️ New Zone System – Green, Orange & Black Zones (Timothée)
[/h2][/b]To balance [b]PvP, building[/b], [b]and exploration[/b], we’ve reworked our zone system!

✅ [b]Green Zones[/b] – Safe areas, no PvP, no building (towns, spawn points)
✅ [b]Orange Zones[/b] – PvP optional (Bandits can attack, but will be marked hostile)
✅ [b]Black Zones[/b] – Full PvP, open-world danger, build anywhere, Claim Territory

💡 [b]New Features:[/b]
✔️ [b]Dynamic Zones[/b] – Special areas that override server-wide rules
✔️ [b]Green Safe Zones at Region Entrances[/b] – Prevents spawn camping
✔️ [b]PvP Arenas in Green Zones[/b] – Controlled battle zones
✔️ [b]Realm Tax System in Orange Zones[/b] – Auto-applied game tax in controlled areas
✔️ [b]Optimized Map Loading[/b] – Load times reduced from 10 min (in some cases) to 1-2 min!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/4edae7247f24a4c84b064d43ddf4b347a893a598.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/4fcacc8bbe9a2afa3491437e2766987b5852d536.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/7bf9b1bd1e2c06d45df31d101e90f799a69b0bb6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/7179a466bd3e283f0e11b03ebc96c3e6c6610e7c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/8880d8c109abd80b35b0eb997679086b0e9a2f36.png[/img]

[b][h2]🍺 New Crafting Stations & Mounts (Jacob)
[/h2][/b][b]🏗️ New Structures:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Brewing Station[/b] – Where dwarves brew legendary drinks! 🍻[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/0923869e9966154d0c59d82d7a9858aee6658368.png[/img]
[*] [b]Cooking Stations[/b] – Each tier brings new possibilities 🍖
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/a113e9231ad266c7d3b809ab1b315d6a8be71d29.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/f8b2f3b6385cdf2bfb012f264a1e0f4f09322c1e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/600a29869801f15f6d9a46a8bcfe6aaf2f7ebdaf.png[/img]
[*] [b]Stables[/b] – Raise and train animals 🐴
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/cdb5b990c27b3b012cebb99557f7ae75aea9e5f5.png[/img]
[*] [b]Ancient Obelisks[/b](Ancient tablette fabricator) – Mystical dwarven technology 🏛️
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/7bffe10ec7f73fe195d7699de29dbd245a4076dc.png[/img]
[/list]
🏇 Mounts are here! Currently, there are two different mounts, but our goal is to make all wild creatures mountable in the future!

[b][h2]🛠 Side Note: Server Meshing Fixes & General Improvements
[/h2][/b]We’ve worked hard to [b]fix a lot of issues with server meshing from the last playtest[/b]. Thanks to community feedback, we’ve been able to [b]optimize performance[/b], [b]improve player synchronization[/b], and make [b]significant stability upgrades[/b].

✅ [b]Major bug fixes[/b] from the last playtest
✅ [b]Server meshing is now much smoother[/b]
✅ [b]Performance optimizations for large-scale battles & interactions[/b]

We look forward to testing these improvements in the next playtest and gathering your feedback!

[b][h2]🔥 Next Playtest Details & How to Join
[/h2][/b]The [b]next playtest is scheduled for March  28th – 30th![/b]

👥 [b]We need more testers[/b]! Help us shape the game and stress-test our systems.
[b]Register here[/b]:
🌐 [url=https://www.mithrall.com]www.mithrall.com
[/url]
If you’ve already registered, [b]you’re all set[/b]! Spread the word, invite your friends, and let’s make this the biggest test yet!

🚀 [b]We’ll keep gathering feedback and improving Mithrall based on your input[/b]. See you in the next test!

[i][b]- The Mithrall Dev Team
[/b][/i]

notes.title: Mithrall Devblog Update & Sneak Peeks
notes.content:
[h1] ⚒️ The Dwarven City. [/h1]

The development team has been hard at work on world-building, in-game mechanics, the main hall, characters, and so much more, while also keeping fans updated and answering your questions!

This peaceful, welcoming hub offers opportunities to trade with vendors, buy and sell items at the auction house, deposit money in the guild bank or personal bank, and meet other dwarves in the bustling meeting hall. You might even venture into the mines to uncover secrets within! And so much more!

Everything is still a work in progress, so if you have any suggestions or ideas, we’d love to hear them! Who knows—your ideas might even make it into the game!

notes.title: Mithrall Closed Playtest!
notes.content:
[h1]⚔️ Launching our Closed Playtest![/h1]
We’re excited to announce that Mithrall is launching a closed playtest starting on November 8, 2024, at 7 PM GMT+2! We've been working hard on the game, and there’s already plenty to experience, but keep in mind this is just the beginning—there’s much more to come in the future!

[h1]🔥 What is our focus?[/h1]
Our main focus is on optimization, balancing, and gathering your feedback and suggestions. We want to hear about your experience while playing and collect any thoughts or concerns you may have. Ultimately, we want you to have fun, enjoy some laughs, and experience a cozy vibe mixed with action and PvP elements.

[h1]🤔 How to participate?[/h1]
If you're interested in playing our game, please fill out the form available here: [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1szPf6FFvbYutrdyIl8lzPYrZpgUi5ltXpdreXstZjG8/viewform?edit_requested=true]Register for the Closed Playtest![/url]

Sign up to secure your spot. Keep in mind, this will be a Closed Playtest, so only registered players will have access. This is a crucial step to help us hunt down bugs and perfect the gameplay experience!

We're eagerly anticipating your feedback and can't wait to hear what you think. Please spread the word and help us bring more adventurers into our crazy dwarven world.

[b]See you in Mithrall soon! ⚒️[/b]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/ed9f6e56d990fe4a0717103f20e912fbad1ed50b.png[/img]
[h1]Join the Upcoming Playtest for "Mithrall"![/h1]

Exciting news from the world of Mithrall! We're gearing up for an early playtest in approximately two months, and you're invited to be part of this crucial phase. This playtest will focus on testing server meshing and many new features we've been diligently working on.


[h2]How to Participate[/h2]

To join the playtest, head over to our [url=https://www.mithrall.com]official website[/url] and register. By signing up, you'll be among the first to experience the innovations we're bringing to the game.


[h2]Key Features to Look Forward To:[/h2]
[list]
  [*][b]Server Meshing:[/b] We've recently implemented server meshing, and we can't wait for you to experience the enhanced gameplay it provides.[/*]
  [*][b]New Map System:[/b] Navigate the world of Mithrall with ease using our new map system.[/*]
  [*][b]Tech Tree Enhancements:[/b] Explore our revamped tech tree to see new and exciting upgrades for your character and equipment.[/*]
  [*][b]Character Customization:[/b] Dive into our improved character creation system and create your unique avatar.[/*]
  [*][b]New Realms and Challenges:[/b] Discover new areas and face fresh challenges with your friends.[/*]
[/list]

[h2]Sneak Peek[/h2]
